---
name: architecture-design
description: Design a traceable architecture from approved requirements, including components, data flow, security boundaries, and trade-offs.
---

# Architecture Design Skill
- Begin only from approved requirements.
- Inspect the repository and reuse established technology decisions.
- Map requirements to components, APIs, data concepts, security boundaries, and operational concerns.
- Include a Mermaid component/context diagram and concise data-flow explanation.
- Document alternatives, trade-offs, risks, and open decisions.
- Explicitly address role authorization, user task-field validation, and concurrent task updates.
- Leave task completion and deletion policy unresolved unless requirements contain an approved decision.
- Include requirement-to-component traceability.
